environment.description: Rails 7.1 application deployed on EC2 behind an AWS ALB with no request validation. The ALB performs TLS termination and basic health checks only. Traffic flows: Client -> ALB (port 443) -> Target Group (port 3000) -> Rails/Puma. No WAF attached. LDAP server is OpenLDAP 2.6 on internal VPC subnet. API keys are issued to internal microservices with no per-field input validation at any layer.

config.network: VPC with LDAP on private subnet, ALB on public subnet
